_meta.source: Round 14 - Direct CDS PDF extraction (UTK, Ball State, USD, WMU)
_meta.purpose: State university residency admit rates from official CDS PDFs

schools.notes: UTK CDS 2024-25 C1: applied 59,764 (in-state 13,520 / oos 45,233 / intl 1,011), admitted 24,863 (in-state 9,478 / oos 15,096 / intl 289). Record 60k+ applications confirmed by UTK press release. Highly selective OOS policy; in-state 70.1% vs OOS 33.4% vs intl 28.6%.

Ball State CDS 2024-25 C1: applied 21,093 (in-state 13,010 / oos 7,018 / intl 1,065), admitted 18,034 (in-state 13,008 / oos 3,961 / intl 1,065). Near-open admissions for in-state (≈100%) and intl (100%); OOS notably selective at 56.4%.

USD CDS 2024-25 C1: applied 5,965 (in-state 2,025 / oos 2,088 / intl 1,852), admitted 5,892 (in-state 2,011 / oos 2,075 / intl 1,806). Near-open admissions for all residency groups (97-99%). High intl applicant share (31% of applicants).

WMU CDS 2024-25 C1: applied 21,701 (in-state 14,718 / oos 6,153 / intl 830), admitted 18,359 (in-state 12,653 / oos 5,439 / intl 267). Intl notably lower at 32.2% vs domestic 86-88%. OOS slightly higher than in-state.
